Name: PerfectionStats
Author: Reichelhz
Description:
IMPORTANT! Mod config is optional, but if you have many mods installed, I recommend using it to avoid conflicts.

[b]PerfectionStats[/b] is the ultimate tracking tool for Stardew Valley completionists. Whether you are playing vanilla or with massive expansions, this mod provides a beautiful and highly customizable interface to track every single detail required for Perfection (and more!).
New Feature: Total Customization & AccessibilityWe believe everyone should be able to track their progress easily.
[list]
[*][b]Visual Color Pickers:[/b] Change the colors of progress bars, backgrounds, and text directly in the Mod Config menu.
[*][b]Accessibility Focused:[/b] Specifically designed to help [b]colorblind players[/b] by allowing custom colors for "Completed" vs "Missing" items. No more guessing!
[*][b]Live Feedback:[/b] The config menu displays color names as you adjust them to guide you.
[/list]What does it track?Get a detailed breakdown of your journey to 100%:
[list]
[*][b]Completion Goals:[/b] Overall Perfection percentage at a glance.
[*][b]Collections:[/b] Fish species caught, Cooking recipes (Known/Cooked), and Crafting recipes.
[*][b]Shipping & Farming:[/b] Tracks Crops grown and Forageables sent.
[*][b]Special Trackers:[/b] Now includes [b]Polyculture progress[/b] (Shipping 15 of each crop)!
[*][b]Social & Discovery:[/b] Museum collection progress and Friendship heart levels (8+ hearts).
[*][b]Combat:[/b] Monster Eradication goals (Monster Hunter).
[/list]Massive Mod CompatibilityPerfectionStats is built to scale. It automatically detects and integrates content from:
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b]
[*][b]Ridgeside Village (RSV)[/b]
[*][i]And other mods that add custom NPCs, Fish, or Items![/i]
[/list]Key Features[list]
[*][b]Interactive UI:[/b] Click on any progress bar to see exactly [b]which items or NPCs you are missing[/b].
[*][b]Optional Mod Config:[/b] Fully compatible with [i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i]. We highly recommend using it to customize your experience and keybinds.
[*][b]Lightweight & Stable:[/b] Built for SMAPI 4.0+ and tested for maximum performance.
[*][b]Localization:[/b] Fully supports translations ([code]i18n[/code]).
[/list]
